name: Sea Mild Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sea Mild Biotechnology Co., Ltd., headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, specializes in the production and distribution of a diverse range of items within the country. Its product portfolio includes paints, coatings, and various cleaning solutions. Operating under its "Sea Mild Biotech" brand, the company supplies specific categories such as laundry, household, and personal detergents, in addition to vital epidemic prevention products.
